baseline_models.focus_anchor: The thani/atfihi posture at words 1-2 and the causative li-yudilla ... sabil construction at words 3-5.
baseline_models.mechanism: The agent folds his own side away and turns that self-direction into the purposive redirection of others. The body is both a display of refusal and an instrument that bends movement away from the intended way.

activation_trace.role: Folding and turning supply the initiating bodily deflection.
The side bent away makes the gesture one of refusal and proud disengagement.
Departure from intended direction is the effect causatively imposed on others.
A traversable extended way spatializes what the agent diverts people from.

changed_reading.before: A proud person adopts dismissive body language while arguing.
changed_reading.after: His bodily turn is itself a routing act: he advertises a deflection and reproduces it in other travelers.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative yudilla at word 3 governs movement away from sabil at word 5.
baseline_models.mechanism: The loss root permits more than choosing the wrong road: concealment and loss make the correct route unavailable to perception or recovery. The misleader can therefore operate by obscuring access as well as by recommending an alternative.

activation_trace.role: Concealment supplies a mechanism in which the way disappears from view.
Loss supplies the traveler's inability to locate or recover the way.
The extended road is the object whose visibility and availability are impaired.

changed_reading.before: Misleading means transmitting an incorrect proposition.
changed_reading.after: Misleading can mean making God's traversable way hidden, lost, or practically unrecoverable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired worldly disgrace and resurrection-day tasting in words 9-15.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah stages consequence in two theaters: public abasement in the near world and first-person sensory verification at the rising event. Tasting converts a future judicial statement into experienced material knowledge.

activation_trace.role: The nearer world supplies the first temporal horizon.
Public abasement and exposure make the first consequence social and visible.
Experiential testing makes the second consequence personally verified.
A day as a severe event marks the decisive second horizon.
Rising and resurrection identify the event in which the second consequence is encountered.
Severe punitive pain gives the tasting its judicial force.
Actual flame gives the future experience a material medium.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists one punishment now and another later.
changed_reading.after: It moves from visible social exposure in the near horizon to direct sensory knowledge of burning at the rising.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence forms a directional relay: a warrantless disputant follows a rebellious source, affiliation makes him the recipient of misguidance, and the focus figure then causatively misguides others. His turned side can thus display an orientation he first received and now transmits.

activation_trace.role: The focus body's turn is the visible hinge through which direction is relayed.
The focus causative action sends others away from the intended direction.
Following behind another supplies the upstream reception of direction.
Opposition and crookedness characterize the source whose line is followed.
Affiliative loyalty makes the directional influence a social attachment.
An earlier causative instance supplies the incoming misguidance in the relay.
Road-leading is inverted toward punishment, exposing the relay's anti-guidance.

structural_cues: 22:3-4 place following, affiliation, misguidance, and inverted guidance immediately before the focus disputant.
22:8 repeats the warrantless-disputation frame immediately before 22:9.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered follow-affiliate-mislead sequence; I infer that 22:9 occupies the next social link. A live alternative is that 22:3-4 and 22:8-9 describe parallel, not serial, types.

changed_reading.before: The focus figure is a self-originating influencer.
changed_reading.after: He is also a relay node who converts received crooked orientation into outgoing causative misguidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby edge-worshipper is stable only while benefit arrives, then reverses onto his face and reaches far misguidance. That sequence turns the focus flank from a static badge of pride into the outward form of a precarious orientation that can flip and then recruit others into its distance.

activation_trace.role: The focus fold supplies an already unstable bodily angle.
Inclination of the side gives the focus posture its directional bias.
Inclination away from a direction makes edge worship a precarious orientation.
Turning a thing over from its face supplies the trial-triggered reversal.
The face as direction makes the reversal a total reorientation.
The resulting state is explicitly departure from guidance.
Distance measures how far the unstable turn carries its subject.

structural_cues: 22:11 sequences conditional stability, trial, bodily inversion, and loss of both temporal horizons.
22:12 names the endpoint as far misguidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two adjacent bodily turns and their directional outcomes; I infer that the focus agent externalizes and propagates the instability shown in 22:11. The agents may instead be distinct portraits.

changed_reading.before: Turning the flank is only deliberate arrogance.
changed_reading.after: It is also the social projection of edge-balanced allegiance: a reversible posture that sends others into the same far displacement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, bodies circle, stand, bow, and lower themselves toward God. The focus body also bends, but away. The same physical capacity is polarized into worshipful orientation and anti-worshipful deflection, making the turned flank a counter-bow.

activation_trace.role: Bending supplies the bodily motion shared with, but redirected against, worship.
The side turned in refusal distinguishes this bend from submission.
Lowering the head supplies the surah-wide bodily direction of submission.
Circling organizes movement around the purified center rather than away from it.
Upright standing supplies one stable ritual posture at the sanctuary.
Bowing and lowering the head supply the positive counterpart to the focus bend.
Lowering oneself in humility completes the sanctuary's posture sequence.

structural_cues: 22:18 places cosmic and human prostration against the subset for whom punishment is due.
22:26 gathers circling, standing, bowing, and prostrating bodies around the house.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contrasting bends and their objects; I assign the anti-bow relation between them. A live alternative is that the focus posture is only a social idiom with no ritual contrast.

changed_reading.after: The posture is a counter-ritual use of the body: curvature directed away from the center to which other bodies bow.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context materializes God's way as guidance to a praised path, access to the sacred mosque, deliberate travel toward a revered destination, and arrivals through mountain passes. The focus misguidance therefore scales from rhetoric to route control: obscuring, diverting, or obstructing embodied access to a shared center.

activation_trace.role: The focus causative verb supplies active diversion from intended direction.
The focus way is already a traversable route rather than a free-floating theme.
Repeated road-leading gives the positive directional process opposed by the focus agent.
Turning others away converts directional error into deliberate obstruction.
The focus route recurs beside the sacred mosque and acquires an access dimension.
Intentional travel toward what is revered gives the route a shared destination.
Open passes between mountains make the approach concrete and geographically plural.

structural_cues: 22:24-27 moves from being guided to a path, through blocking the way and mosque, to travelers arriving from every deep pass.
22:25 makes resident and visitor equal at the shared sanctuary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical recurrence and an access sequence; I infer that personal misguidance and institutional obstruction are scalable forms of one routing mechanism. The focus agent may remain only a rhetorician.

changed_reading.before: He persuades listeners to adopt a wrong belief.
changed_reading.after: He interferes with a lived route to a shared sanctuary, so misguidance can include social and spatial denial of access.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus forecast is replayed as a loop: sufferers attempt to pass outward, are returned, and are told to taste the same burning punishment; the tasting formula then recurs beside obstruction of God's way. Punishment is not one instant but repeated sensory verification under denied egress.

activation_trace.role: The focus prediction defines punishment as personally tested experience.
Punitive pain gives the experience judicial force.
Flame supplies the material repeatedly encountered.
Attempted passage to the outside introduces an escape trajectory.
Return after departure closes the attempted trajectory into a loop.
The focus mode of experiential testing is explicitly repeated inside the loop.
The same punitive category confirms continuity with the focus forecast.
The same burning medium completes the near-verbatim replay.
Tasting recurs in the verse that names obstruction of God's way.
Punishment directly links the obstruction scene to the focus consequence.

structural_cues: 22:19-22 encloses bodies in material fire and repeats the focus phrase after each attempted exit.
22:25 places another tasting formula in the same sentence as blocking God's way and the sacred mosque.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrence, attempted exit, forced return, and the obstruction-tasting link; I infer a reciprocal blocker-becomes-blocked pattern. A live alternative is simple elaboration without measure-for-measure force.

changed_reading.before: The future clause promises a single later experience of fire.
changed_reading.after: The promised tasting unfolds as a recursive denied-exit experience and echoes back onto the act of denying others a way.

context_deltas.mechanism: Travel through the earth is presented as enabling hearts to reason, while the actual blindness lies in hearts; later guidance terminates in a straight path. A way is therefore an epistemic instrument, not merely a destination. Diverting people from it deprives them of the movement that could correct inner blindness.

activation_trace.role: Concealment lets misguidance operate by keeping corrective orientation unavailable.
The traversable way supplies the medium of corrective movement.
Going and flowing through the earth initiates the context's learning process.
The heart is named both as the organ enabled by travel and as the organ that can remain blind.
Reason as a restraint on ignorance supplies the cognitive result of travel.
Inner blindness identifies the condition that an unblocked journey could expose and correct.
Gentle road-leading supplies the positive epistemic direction.
Straightness and rectitude define the path's corrected orientation.

structural_cues: 22:46 grammatically links traveling in the earth with acquiring hearts that reason and ears that hear.
22:54 links recognized truth, yielding hearts, and guidance to a straight path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies travel-to-reason and truth-to-straight-guidance sequences; I infer that blocking the path disables a corrective feedback process. A live alternative is that physical travel only furnishes evidence, while the focus way remains doctrinal.

changed_reading.before: God's way is an external route leading to a destination.
changed_reading.after: The way is also a learning process; diverting someone from it can preserve the heart's blindness by preventing corrective travel.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus posture is framed by coiled dispute without guidance or illuminating warrant. Near the surah's end, worship without authoritative proof and visible denial on faces approach bodily assault against reciters. The turned flank can therefore function as coercive body language within an escalation from argument to intimidation.

activation_trace.role: The refusing side gives disputation a visible bodily force.
Causative diversion identifies the social result sought by the display.
Twisted adversarial disputation supplies the immediate speech setting.
Compelling proof is precisely absent, leaving coercion without warrant.
The visible front of the body carries denial before threatened action.

structural_cues: 22:8 supplies the focus person's warrantless-disputation frame.
22:72 moves from recognizable denial on faces to near-assault on those reciting the signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated warrantless dispute and a later face-to-assault sequence; I infer an escalation mechanism joining them. The later hostile group need not be the individual of 22:9.

changed_reading.before: The flank turn merely describes the speaker's attitude.
changed_reading.after: It is performative intimidation: a bodily stage in enforcing misdirection when compelling proof is absent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later transmission scene contains a thrown intrusion, its removal, the securing of signs, and renewed guidance to straightness. This activates an informational reading of the focus: the sideways human posture introduces a perturbation into the communicative route, while correction removes the insertion and restores direction.

activation_trace.role: Inclination supplies the sideways perturbation in the focus scene.
Concealment supplies the informational effect of the perturbation.
Casting an item into a stream supplies the intrusive insertion.
Crooked opposition identifies the insertion's adversarial source.
Removal followed by replacement supplies the first repair operation.
Securing and perfecting supply the stabilization of the signs after removal.
Restored road-leading supplies the repaired transmission's effect.
Straightness marks the recovered direction after correction.

structural_cues: 22:52 orders casting, removal, and securing within one transmission sequence.
22:53-54 contrasts vulnerable hearts with knowledgeable hearts that yield and are guided straight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an insertion-repair-guidance sequence; I analogize the focus misleader to human-scale interference in a message route. A live alternative is that the later sequence concerns a different mechanism and only shares adversarial direction.

changed_reading.before: The focus agent only redirects people interpersonally.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, he also models informational interference: a sideways insertion that obscures a message until its route is repaired.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the numerical and road-bend branches of thani rather than treating the word only as an idiom of posture. It remains anchored in focus word 1 beside the explicit way at word 5 and is sharpened by later intended, open, and straight routes. Downstream prose should call it an imagistic second-road model, not a grammatical replacement for the ordinary construction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Thani at word 1 read beside sabil at word 5.

activation_trace.role: Making one into two supplies a duplicate route alongside the first.
A bend in a mountain or valley road gives the duplicate the shape of a detour.
The traversable way is the primary route beside which the detour is imagined.
A clear intended road supplies the legitimate route toward the revered center.
Wide passes between mountains make road branching spatially imaginable.
Straightness distinguishes the authorized orientation from the manufactured detour.

changed_reading.before: A person turns his side while drawing others off one road.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, he manufactures a second, bent road beside the intended one and makes the detour look traversable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates material cord and trap branches beneath a bodily idiom. It remains anchored in the doubled/turned focus posture and its causative effect, with later cord-cutting and holding-fast language supplying a coherent attachment topology. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for manipulated allegiance, not as the lexical sense demanded by 22:9.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled turn at words 1-2 as the mechanism serving causative misguidance at word 3.

activation_trace.role: A cord doubled at its ends supplies a line capable of redirecting what is attached.
A bent trap supplies capture through controlled curvature.
Directional displacement is the effect produced on the captured attachment.
A cord or connection supplies an explicit attachment line elsewhere in the surah.
Severing supplies the destructive alternative to a stable connection.
A fastening held onto supplies the positive counter-image of secure attachment to God.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it works by manipulating attachment: a doubled lead or bent snare reroutes allegiance away from a secure hold.

strongest_changes: The focus figure becomes a relay node who converts received crooked orientation into outgoing causative misguidance.
God's way becomes an embodied and institutional route to the sanctuary, so misguidance includes obstruction of movement and access.
The repeated tasting language turns final fire into recursive denied egress and echoes consequence back onto path obstruction.
Edge worship, reversal, prostration, and straight guidance polarize the flank turn as unstable anti-worship rather than mere attitude.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly re-materialized the focus geometry: body angle became pilgrimage routing, heart cognition, message transmission, and an exit-return punishment loop without forcing those mechanisms into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The relay model depends on reading adjacent disputants as a social chain rather than independent examples.
The sanctuary-access model may scale an individual rhetorician into institutional obstruction more strongly than the focus alone permits.
The second-road and tethered-snare outliers remain productive material analogies but are deliberately branch-distant.
